_meta.scope: Singleton handoff: tamu-qfin (Texas A&M Mays / Math MS Quantitative Finance, MS-QFIN). DISTINCT from tamu-msf (classic MS Finance = TAMU undergrad 4+1 only; batch3 tuition null + accessRestricted).
_meta.rule: Never invent; missing ≠ 0. Figures from primary TAMU catalog / SBS / Math Grad pages as of asOf.
_meta.schIdNote: No batch4-awards.json under /workspace/aid-msf/ as of write. Batch3 ended SCH-115. This singleton uses no SCH ids (zero verified awards). Future tamu-qfin awards → SCH-130+ (headroom after Batch3; Batch4 in flight may claim SCH-116–129).

crossCheck.note: Brief and aid agree: flat program tuition null; SBS Quantitative Finance Prog Fee $15,000/Sem Fall/Spring only. Aid adds published 2026–27 nonresident per-SCH rate as tuitionEstimate components only.

tamu-qfin.tuitionEstimateLabel: Nonresident graduate base tuition only — 36 SCH × $836.40 (SBS Graduate & Certificate Non-Resident Fall 2026 / Spring 2027 schedule). NOT a published flat MS-QFIN sticker; excludes program fee, college fees, insurance, living. Fall 2027 / AY 2027–28 rates not published as of asOf.
tamu-qfin.feesNote: SBS Billing & Fee Explanations: Quantitative Finance Prog Fee $15,000 per semester (Fall/Spring only) for MS Quantitative Finance students. Same dollar amount listed on 2026–27 Non-Resident and Resident GR DoD PDFs under 'MS in Quantitative Finance' $15,000. MAYS Masters Program Fee ($244.45/SCH or flat $2,200 at 9+ SCH) and Business college fees also appear on SBS schedules — whether stacked with QFIN fee for every enrollee is not itemized as a full-degree total on program pages. Term count for traditional external path not published → cannot sum program fees into verified full-degree fees integer (missing ≠ invent).
tamu-qfin.period: Rate components from Fall 2026 / Spring 2027 SBS schedules (proxy). Fall 2027 billing rates not locked.
tamu-qfin.notes: OPEN external/intl per official catalog: admission available to current Texas A&M sophomore/junior/senior students OR non-Texas A&M graduates meeting prerequisites (ACCT/ECON/MATH with B or higher). External/intl pathway via Department of Mathematics GraduateCAS (artsci Math master's appinfo). DISTINCT from tamu-msf (classic MS Finance = TAMU undergrad 4+1 only; accessRestricted). 36 credit hours, non-thesis, joint Finance + Mathematics ('STEM to Stocks'). No flat program tuition on Mays/catalog — use SBS rates + calculator. Program fee $15,000/Fall&Spring sem (SBS). STEM/CIP designation not stated on official QFIN catalog/Math pages → stem null. Living band not program-published → livingCostBand null. Calendar length (1 vs 2 years) not stated on catalog.
tamu-qfin.startTerm: Fall 2027 (Math Grad Master's table also lists Spring; QFIN-specific start month not labeled on catalog)
tamu-qfin.duration: 36 semester credit hours, non-thesis (catalog). Calendar length not stated on official catalog page.
tamu-qfin.accessNote: Catalog + Math GradCAS: open to non-Texas A&M graduates (and current TAMU UG). Math Master's departmental deadlines (take precedence over GradCAS site): Fall intl May 15 / domestic July 1; Spring intl Sept 15 / domestic Dec 1. Do NOT reuse classic tamu-msf 4+1 Lightning/Round dates (TAMU undergrads only). Mays 4+1 MSF marketing is separate.

altTuition.note: Program fee is per Fall/Spring semester, not a one-time total. Base tuition arithmetic uses published 2026–27 SBS per-SCH rates × 36; does not include college fees or insurance.

deadlines.fallInternational: May 15 (Math Master's departmental — year of intended Fall entry; for Fall 2027 → 2027-05-15)
deadlines.note: From Artsci Math Application Information for Master's Program (GraduateCAS). Late apps may be accepted only after contacting gstudies@math.tamu.edu. QFIN-specific Mays deadline board not posted as of asOf — do not conflate with 4+1 MSF rounds.
